北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天体感 31℃，湿度较高，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with high humidity. Remember to drink more water!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 5级，体感 29℃，出门小心，注意防风哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has strong winds (level 5), feels like 29℃. Be careful outside, mind the wind!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 35℃，外出防晒，记得多喝水解暑哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 35℃. Protect from sun, remember to drink plenty of water to cool down!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州湿度 93%，闷热感强，注意防潮，保持干爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is 93% humid, feeling stuffy. Mind moisture and stay dry.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨，体感 26℃，出门带伞，路面湿滑小心走。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain, feels like 26℃. Take an umbrella, watch for slippery roads.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 36℃，天气炎热，注意防暑降温哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like 36℃. It's hot, remember heatstroke prevention!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 35℃，紫外线强，防晒补水很重要哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 35℃. UV is strong, sun protection and hydration are key!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 38℃，天气酷热干燥，务必多喝水防暑！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 38℃. Extremely hot and dry, be sure to drink plenty of water for heatstroke prevention!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 37℃，高温炎热，避免长时间户外活动。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like 37℃. High temperature and heat, avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 32℃，风力 4级，多云，注意防晒补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 32℃ with level 4 winds. Partly cloudy, remember sun protection and hydration.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴天 38℃，风力 5级，多喝水，注意防晒避暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny at 38℃ with level 5 winds. Drink plenty of water, mind sun protection and avoid heat!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨湿度 79%，多云，注意防潮，保持舒适哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is 79% humid and partly cloudy. Mind moisture and stay comfortable!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳湿度 86%，体感 31℃，保持清爽，注意补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is 86% humid, feels like 31℃. Stay refreshed and hydrated.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨 20℃，体感舒适，出门记得带把伞哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain at 20℃, feels pleasant. Remember an umbrella when you go out.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，湿度 83%，风力 4级，小心湿滑，注意补水。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, 83% humid with level 4 winds. Watch for slipperiness, stay hydrated.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛湿度 90%，体感 28℃，多云，注意防潮哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is 90% humid, feels like 28℃. Partly cloudy, mind the dampness.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连湿度 81%，多云体感 29℃，注意补水，保持舒适。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is 81% humid, feels like 29℃. Stay hydrated and comfortable.
